1. kitze/skillbox (★ 283 · 28 forks · TypeScript · MIT)
Self-Hosted Versioned Skills Registry with Scoped Grants & Jev Routing
• Immutable Revisions & Profiles: Per-profile skill/bundle grants & owner review
• Dual MCP Delivery: HTTP /mcp + Node/Bun stdio bridge + commit-pinned GitHub import
• Optional Jev Recommendations: AES-256-GCM encrypted keys for TypeSafe/OpenRouter
• React + Bun + Hono + PostgreSQL 16+ · Never executes uploaded skill code
2. boringcomputers/goshen-email (★ 188 · 18 forks · TypeScript)
Scoped Email Inboxes for AI Agents with Idempotent Send & Quarantine Gate
• 17 OpenAPI / CLI / MCP Operations: Create inboxes, send, receive & thread replies
• Least-Privilege Keys: Mailbox keys reach 1 inbox; no API key can release quarantine
• Anti-Abuse SMTP Pipeline: SPF/DKIM/DMARC + Rspamd + ClamAV + idempotency keys
• Human dashboard for quarantine release & signed delivery webhooks
3. sazabi/cve.now (★ 167 · 10 forks · Apache-2.0)
8-Source Unified Vulnerability Feed & Keyless Security MCP Server
• 8 Merged Feeds: CVE List, GHSA, OSV, NVD, ENISA EUVD, CISA KEV, EPSS & Exploit-DB
• Deduplicated Single Entry: One canonical record per vulnerability with EPSS/KEV
• Zero-Key Multi-Protocol Access: RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, JSON API & MCP server
• Filter by critical (CISA KEV / CVSS 9+ / CVSS 7+ with EPSS ≥ 0.1) or vendor stack
4. cporter202/ai-agent-data-apis (★ 51 · 13 forks · MIT)
2,070 Production Web Data Actors & 150+ Live APIs for MCP & RAG
